```plato

    // The vertex array with a bend constraint's four vertices replaced, in one
    // rebuild rather than four.
    WithFourVertices(self: Array<ClothVertex>, c: ClothBendConstraint, a: ClothVertex, b: ClothVertex, wingC: ClothVertex, wingD: ClothVertex)
        : Array<ClothVertex>
        => self.Count.MapRange(i =>
            i == c.VertexA.Value ? a
            : (i == c.VertexB.Value ? b
            : (i == c.VertexC.Value ? wingC
            : (i == c.VertexD.Value ? wingD : self[i]))));
```
